title: Checking a flexible part with a gauge
titleZh: 用量具檢查有彈性的零件

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Your report says the new rubber strips are thinner than the sample we approved. Did you check the approved strip on the same gauge?
turns.zh: 你們報告說新版橡膠條比我們核准的樣品薄。你們有用同一部量具量過核准的膠條嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. I measured both with the lever pulled all the way down. The reading for the approved strip was lower than the value on its card, too.
turns.zh: 有。我把拉桿一路壓到底後量了兩條。核准那條的讀值也比它卡片上記的數值低。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: That lever can squeeze rubber. Lower it just until the tip touches the strip, then stop. Check the approved strip that way first. If its reading matches the card, use that approach on the new strips.
turns.zh: 那支拉桿會壓縮橡膠。往下壓到測頭剛碰到膠條就停。先用這個方式量核准的膠條。若讀值和卡片一致，再用同樣方式量新版膠條。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Understood. If the approved strip still reads low, I'll note the result and ask our gauge team to check the instrument before we measure the new strips again.
turns.zh: 了解。如果核准的膠條讀值還是偏低，我會記下結果，請量具小組先檢查這部儀器，再重測新版膠條。
